`pancapetansca vicnaya visno svapetaneva ca nirtosatvan kunotrekan cnatva nuktirnacanyateti pancapetacnanasatyatvasnaranatatartan pravrtanapi cirantanasastranativitatakanpirataya na nantanan sukena pavatatityarta yatyapipakavanityotkrsta tatapi vyaktivisesapiprayenotkarsaprartanaya atra kriyananatvatasirartakalotprayokopapati yatva, vivaksapetena cakatpatan vyastan sanastan ca tantranyayena
